pages.text: Plant a Pure Daisy and start generating mana — Botania is the Tier 1 magic-cultivation mod, and the Magic lane's first token source.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Your first mana system. Manasteel is the T1 magic material ceiling. Botania's Orechid is datapack-restricted so it cannot tier-skip: Diamond, Osmium, and Ancient Debris are disabled, so it yields only lower-tier ores.$(br2)$(bold)Key IridescentCraft interactions:$() Botania mana tools are affected by Faefolk's Nature Magic racial (+15% effectiveness). Mana reagents and apparatus bank Magic-lane tokens via $(bold)/icraft codex submit$().

$(bold)Tier gating:$() Terrasteel and Elementium are T3 materials in this pack — crafting them requires T3 to be unlocked. Manasteel and Mana Pearl are the T1–T2 ceiling.$(br2)$(bold)Gaia Guardian:$() Summoned Botania capstone, T4 content. Drops Magiblade unique weapon (20%) and Gaia Spirit Fragments. Scales progressively.

$(bold)Where the documentation lives:$() this Codex replaces the individual mod guidebooks in this pack. Every Botania recipe is in JEI, and the flower and ritual mechanics you need for progression are covered in the $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)Magic lane$(/l) pages.$(br2)$(bold)Next: Pure Daisy → livingwood → your first mana spreader and pool.$()
